description: List who signed in to a private status page: each viewer's address, first and last visit, saved passkeys, whether they subscribe by email, and whether they are blocked; and for the page password, which names nobody, the devices signed in with it, its last sign-in and the wrong tries in 24 hours. Addresses are customer data. Read-only.
name: list_status_page_viewers

PagePasswordUse.description:
How the page password is used. Password visitors are anonymous, so this is
all there is to see of them.

last_sign_in.description: Last sign-in with it, RFC 3339, if any.

sessions.description: Devices signed in with it now.

wrong_tries_24h.description: Wrong passwords tried in the last 24 hours.

PageViewerItem.description:
`list_status_page_viewers` result row: someone who signed in to a private
page.

subscribed.description: Whether they get the page's updates by email.

password.description: `null` for a page never made private.

title: List status page viewers
